structured.feedback: Meets the core requirements: about 250 words, Markdown with five relevant subheadings, active voice mostly, no links, no invented quotes, no mention of the stiffness complaint, and a clear call to action. Minor issues: "adjustable" tie lengths embellishes the review ("love the tie lengths"), some repetition of "smooth" and "protection," and the "wake up with less to fix" and "expect your style to stay put" lines lean slightly toward overpromising.
